name: Cafe Nuovo & Diamond Cocktail Bar
kurzbeschreibung: Café Nuovo & Diamond Cocktail Bar in Tirol Discover the perfect blend of Viennese charm and Alpine flair at Café Nuovo & Diamond Cocktail Bar in the heart of Tirol.
beschreibung: The Cafe Nuovo & Diamond Cocktail Bar in Kufstein impresses with an upscale drinks menu and a stylish modern interior. The chic bar is the perfect place to wind down after a day in Tirol with an exquisite cocktail, craft beer, or fine glass of wine. The menu also offers tasty savory bites and platters designed to pair seamlessly with drinks, accompanied by vibrant lounge music and attentive service.
